description: Informe del Sistema Eléctrico. Red Eléctrica de España is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Cántabro de Estadística. Electrical System Report. Red Eléctrica (Spain). Coverage: Instituto Cántabro de Estadística. The portal shows the English title as "Electrical System Report. Red Eléctrica (Spain)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto Cántabro de Estadística. Its keywords include Energía. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, PC-AXIS, HTML. The listing shows 2026-09-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.icane.es/footer/legal-advisory). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
